title: Slow Productivity: The Lost Art of Accomplishment Without Burnout
author: Cal Newport
engineRationale: Though the topic (a philosophy of work / avoiding burnout) is abstract, Newport builds his entire argument on SPECIFIC, nameable historical knowledge workers — Galileo, Newton, Jane Austen, John McPhee, Georgia O'Keeffe, Benjamin Franklin, Lin-Manuel Miranda. These documentary scenes of real figures are the book's engine, making photoreal Flux cut-outs (Vox) a far stronger fit than an abstract everyman vector rig.
